checks.description: Text and meaningful UI clear WCAG 2.2 AA contrast against the fixed palette: #141414 background, #1A1A1A cards, emerald #009975 accent. Normal text at least 4.5:1, large text and UI at least 3:1.
checks.rule: Fail when any text or meaningful UI falls below AA contrast. Emerald #009975 as body text on #141414 or #1A1A1A is the common fail; the fix uses #FFFFFF for body text and reserves emerald for large headings and accents, never the palette itself.

checks.description: Logical order matches visual order in Arabic, no LTR leakage, layout mirrored, Western numerals preserved in rendered text.
checks.rule: Fail when the Arabic reading order does not match the visual order, when LTR layout leaks into an Arabic page or email, or when numerals render as Eastern Arabic-Indic digits.

checks.description: Every meaningful image has an alt-text slot for the author, decorative images are marked decorative, no meaning is carried by image alone, no Arabic is baked into a generated image.
checks.rule: Fail when a meaningful image lacks an alt-text slot, when a decorative image is not marked decorative, when meaning is carried only by an image, or when Arabic text is baked into a generated image.

checks.description: One logical heading order, landmarks present, lists marked as lists; an email carries semantic structure and a plain-text alternative, never image-only.
checks.rule: Fail when heading order is not logical, when landmarks or list semantics are missing, or when an email is image-only without a plain-text alternative.

checks.description: Every link and button has a descriptive label, no bare click-here equivalents, signup-gate fields have programmatic labels.
checks.rule: Fail when a link or button lacks a descriptive label, when it uses a bare label such as click-here or its Arabic equivalent, or when a form field lacks a programmatic label.

checks.description: Interactive targets are large enough and not crowded, usable on mobile.
checks.rule: Fail when interactive targets are too small or too crowded to use reliably on a touch screen.

checks.description: Focusable in a sensible order, focus visible, nothing reachable only on hover or pointer.
checks.rule: Fail when focus order is illogical, when the focus indicator is not visible, or when any control is reachable only by hover or pointer.

checks.description: No state or meaning conveyed by color alone.
checks.rule: Fail when a state or meaning (error, required, selected, available) is conveyed by color alone, with no text, icon, or other non-color cue.

checks.description: No autoplay that cannot be paused, nothing flashing, motion respects reduced-motion.
checks.rule: Fail when motion autoplays without a pause control, when content flashes, or when a reduced-motion preference is ignored.

checks.description: A spec-only review blocks final pass on the checks that need a live render.
checks.rule: Fail (block final pass) when the review is spec-only and a render-dependent check (measured contrast, focus order) cannot be verified without a render; flag it as an open item rather than passing it through.

checks.description: The gate returns a binary verdict with a structured fix list on fail.
checks.rule: Result is pass only when every check passes; otherwise fail with one fix item per failing check, each naming the check, the offending element, and the required change.
